status: Development companion; not submitted to the App Store or TestFlight
simulator: Local simulator builds do not need an Apple Developer membership. Distribution and physical-device signing require developer-owned provisioning.
configuration: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL can use an HTTPS server origin. Development builds also accept localhost, 127.0.0.1 or Android's 10.0.2.2 over HTTP. Never put a server secret in EXPO_PUBLIC variables.
auth: Better Auth Expo manages the session cookie in iOS Keychain using this-device-only protection. General API calls send that cookie only to the configured API. Native Google uses the system authentication browser and twospace://auth/callback; Expo Go is not a supported sign-in environment.
implemented: Verified email signup and password-reset requests
Create or join a space; share invitation codes
Notes, photos, replies, reactions and pins
Questions with answers hidden until both reply
Four in a row with server revision checks
Plans, partner-local times and checklist updates
Profile settings, leave space and sign out
data: Cloud data is fetched on launch and every four seconds while active. Text drafts and API snapshots stay in memory. Selected photos use system-managed temporary files; generated JPEG upload files are removed after reading. Requests expose connection errors and do not pretend unsent changes were saved.
artwork: Section emblems were generated for TwoSpace. The native icon is an opaque, resized derivative of the existing generated TwoSpace brand image.

findings.issue: Signup confirmation vanished when the account query reset
findings.fix: Keep the verification message visible until the user signs in; reset the account gate only when a session exists

findings.issue: Failed private photos could not retry with an unchanged media ID
findings.fix: Add an explicit retry that remounts the authenticated image request

findings.issue: Text typed while saving could be cleared without being submitted
findings.fix: Lock the affected draft fields and close controls during their mutation

findings.issue: Nested board accessibility hid occupied cells from VoiceOver
findings.fix: Describe each column's six cells in its accessibility value

findings.issue: Expo fingerprint included a vulnerable minimatch version
findings.fix: Scope a minimatch11.0.1 override to fingerprint; npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities

findings.issue: iPhone HEIC originals were sent to a JPEG/WebP server decoder
findings.fix: Encode selected photos as JPEG on-device before upload, enforce the original pixel and byte limits plus the converted byte limit, and remove temporary conversion files

verification.nativeBuild: Xcode27.1 unsigned arm64 iOS simulator build succeeded, including the native photo-conversion modules
verification.interactiveSimulatorReview: Not completed: DeviceHub could not be controlled through the available UI automation
verification.photoConversionOnDevice: Not verified; pipeline tests cover conversion ordering, limits and cleanup using an injected encoder

localBuildNote: On this host, the synced Documents folder adds Finder metadata that can break framework signing during npm run ios. Build a checkout outside synced folders if this occurs. Local verification used Expo’s supported EXPO_CUSTOM_BUILD_ROOT=/tmp/TwoSpaceExpoJSI and generated JSI products outside the synced folder. No workaround scripts, generated native files, broad metadata removal or security-setting changes are committed.
